name: Bear Mountain
summary: Steel fire tower on Bear Mountain's summit, dated 1923 by the register, removed around 1930; the stone Perkins tower beside it still stands.
design: steel frame tower with nine landings and an observation cab
status_note: Steel tower removed; the stone Perkins Memorial Tower about 300 ft away still stands. The register reports footings on the summit rock.

access.note: Summit lies within Harriman/Bear Mountain State Park. Only footings are reported at the steel tower site.

visit.trail_note: The Appalachian Trail passes the base of the stone Perkins Memorial Tower, which the register says is open to the public.

events.note: Steel fire tower erected on the summit by the State Park Commission, with the State Conservation Department; 60 feet, nine landings
1929 newspaper describes a steel fire observation tower recently raising the summit eighty feet; conflicts with the 1923 date
Register main text says removed in 1930, hedged as 'it's said'; its epilog gives 1930 unhedged; a 1932 survey still describes the tower, and a 2005 note says gone before 1965
